normalization_detail.degeneracy_proof: Because the source middle and deep values are both 1.65, the multiset of per-point source values under partition (1,2,1) equals that under the reference partition (1,1,2): [0.58, 1.65, 1.65, 1.65]. The normalization rule divides each point by the same weighted mean 1.3825, so the per-point multiplier list is identical to mapping C. Since run_layerwise_experiment.py applies multipliers per injection point, partition D is predicted to produce bitwise-identical outputs to the already-run mapping C. This file exists to turn that analytic claim into a 3-object identity check.
